title: Bid slider and custom field Options live beside the AuctionBid box in the stack
trigger: slider and custom are Some only while an AuctionBid is on the stack, cleared by after_market_pop.
effect: Two Options must follow one stack entry by hand (see the market_replace bug).
fix: Move them into MarketBox::AuctionBid{gift_id, bid: BidUi}.

title: pending_auction bool kept in step with session auction_loading and auction_ready
trigger: Tile or link asks for an auction: pending_auction=true, driver sets auction_loading, reducer sets auction_ready; the frame upkeep ends pending when either changes.
effect: Three fields carry one stage (idle, loading, ready, failed).
fix: enum AuctionOpen { Idle, Loading{request}, Ready{gift_id} }.

title: forge_started Option<Instant> and craft_primary Option next to the Craft stack boxes
trigger: Craft flow: craft_primary is set for CraftInfo, forge_started marks the forge, the box shown comes from stack and session craft.
effect: The craft stage is spread over stack top, session.craft and two UI Options.
fix: One CraftStage enum (Info, Select, Forging{since}, Result) in the box variant.

title: ResaleSearch loading/loaded/error flags
trigger: The resale box reads search.loaded, search.loading and search.error together to pick empty text, spinner or Show more.
effect: Three fields for one fetch stage per page.
fix: Fetch<Page> per search generation.

title: GiveawayForm.confirming bool beside page enum and the session's launch state
trigger: Form, 'are you sure', pick pages, launching and launched are chosen in giveaway_form_body by checking launch, confirming, page in that order.
effect: Five stages across three fields in two owners.
fix: enum FormStage { Editing(Page), Confirming, Launching, Launched, Failed } on the form.

title: Per-window glyph sweep is pending: Option, sweep_when_idle: bool, kept/seen counters in step
trigger: Idle trim begins a sweep (begin), the next render finishes it (start_frame), a window goes to the background (window_activation).
effect: No user-visible bug found. A pending sweep waits for a render of that window; a window that is hidden and never renders keeps pending (no new sweep for it) until it closes (forget_closed_windows) or draws.
fix: enum Sweep { Idle, Marked(PendingSweep) } plus an idle-trigger enum; or clear Marked when the window reports it is hidden.

title: Stream overlay and key reveal are two fields kept in step by hand
trigger: Any open/close of the stream window boxes.
effect: See P2-001; also the overlay is only cleared by StreamWindow::clear, not by sync_group_call_boxes, so it outlives a changed call while a live PiP keeps the stream.
fix: One enum for the stream window box (none, settings with key hidden/shown, speakers, leave, revoke, warning) owned by the screen, dropped with the call in sync_group_call_boxes.

title: StreamWindow holds several staged fields: hide_armed + hide_task, photo (None while blurring) + photo_task, title_pressed
trigger: Hover/move in full screen (arm_stream_hide_timer), first frame of a stream with a chat photo (group_call_stream_photo).
effect: No bug found: hide_armed is cleared when the loop ends; photo/photo_task are replaced together. A blur that fails leaves (path, None) for good, with no retry (cosmetic).
fix: hide timer as Option<Task> alone (armed iff Some, cleared by the task's last step); photo as Fetch<Arc<RenderImage>> keyed by path.

title: Sticker pack loading derived from request purposes plus stickers.failed flags
trigger: Press Load packs in the Edit box
effect: busy/loading come from has_purpose over two purposes and session.stickers.*.failed sits beside them; no stage enum
fix: Fetch<T> for each pack list.

title: Edit box stage is saving + title_empty + title_emoji + type_box + history_box + photo/photo_note
trigger: Edit, Save, open sub boxes, emoji panel
effect: Stage is derived partly from the session (requests, errors) and partly from five fields in the box and the shared media panel; Saved is a derived state that is never applied
fix: enum EditBoxStage owned by the box: Editing{sub: None|Type|History|Emoji}, Saving(ids), Failed{field,reason}.

title: Title emoji panel is edit.title_emoji AND pickers.media_panel open, kept in step by hand
trigger: Open the name field emoji panel, close the panel with Esc/outside click, or let the box turn Saved
effect: title_emoji stays true after the shared panel closes; close_group_title_emoji only closes the panel when group_edit_box() is Some, so a box that became Saved while the panel was open leaves the panel open
fix: The panel's open state carries its owner (MediaPanelOwner::GroupTitle) in one value.

title: Boost list is loading + error + boosts + next_offset
trigger: Open Boosts, switch All/Gifts tab, press Show more
effect: Page stage read from state.loading, state.error and next_offset together (error and loading can both be set); tab is state.only_gifts set by the request, not by the page
fix: Fetch<Page> with a tab key (BoostTab) carried by the request and checked on the answer.

title: reported, slider and release subscription are three keyed states kept in step by render
trigger: Render the slider; change the value from outside.
effect: reported mirrors the caller value, the slider holds the thumb, the subscription holds a clone of reported; correctness depends on the order of updates in render. Keyed by (kind, chat) only, so two windows of one chat share names but not state.
fix: One keyed state enum Synced(value) / Dragging(position).

title: save_refused flag and version counter drive the link status line
trigger: Press Save with an empty or bad link, then switch Public to Private and back.
effect: save_refused is a bool cleared only by a link edit; it stays set when the user flips Public/Private so the empty link shows 'too short' again without a new Save press. version is a keystroke token for the timer.
fix: Fold into one LinkCheck enum (Idle, Typed{version}, Refused{version}) cleared by choose_group_public too.

title: forum_chats_peek and forum_column_shown are two bools kept in step by the render path
trigger: Open a forum chat, press 'Chats' to peek, then resize the window or open a non-forum chat.
effect: forum_column_layout (called while rendering, takes &mut self) both resets forum_chats_peek and records forum_column_shown; derived state written every frame and the peek ends only when something renders.
fix: One enum ForumColumnState {Hidden, Column, Peek} in ChatUi, derived from the layout in one place, not written from render.

title: Topic info toggle is a bare bool on ChatUi
trigger: Click the topic info button in the topic strip.
effect: chat_ui.topic_info_open is flipped by hand and is not tied to the open topic; it stays set when the user selects another topic or leaves to the topic list.
fix: Make it part of an enum of the thread view (TopicList / Topic{id, info_open}) so leaving the topic drops it.

title: Welcome edit target is an Option<i32> not tied to the loaded list
trigger: Start editing a welcome message that is then deleted or replaced by an update.
effect: dialog.editing keeps pointing at an id that may be gone; Save sends editChatWelcomeMessage for a missing id and nothing on screen shows the edit.
fix: Drop editing when the id leaves welcome_messages, or hold the edited message's id and text in one enum variant.

title: Probe cache Entry is a proper enum but Probing has no way out if its task is dropped
trigger: The QuillApp entity or the task is dropped between background_spawn and the result being stored (app shutdown only today).
effect: No bug today: Probing, Known and Unreadable are one enum with a retry timer. A dropped continuation would leave Probing for that path until the 1024-entry reset, so the HDR tag never appears.
fix: Store the probe task handle in the Probing variant, or store the result from the background job itself (not the foreground continuation).

title: HdrViewer keeps its decode and window stage in key + token + slot + in_flight + polling + edr_on + edr_lost + headroom
trigger: Open an HDR picture file in the viewer, step to the next item, move the window to another screen, close the viewer.
effect: Nothing wrong today, but in_flight duplicates Slot::Decoding (a bigger re-decode keeps Slot::Hdr while in_flight is true), polling is a 'task started' flag cleared by the task itself (stays true if its update_in fails), and edr_on/edr_lost mirror window state by hand; reset() clears some and not others.
fix: One enum Decode { Idle, Decoding{key,token,showing:Option<HdrPixels>}, Sdr, StandardRange, Hdr{key,pixels} } and a separate WindowMode { Sdr, Edr, EdrLost } owned by the window; the poll task handle lives in the Hdr variant so dropping the variant stops it.

title: HistoryA11y holds focus stage as bar_focused bool + focused bool + announce_first Option beside ChatUi::selection_focus
trigger: Screen-reader focus moves between the bar and rows, the history gains/loses keyboard focus, an empty chat receives its first messages.
effect: Three fields and a second owner (selection_focus) must change together; bar_focused true makes selection_focus meaningless, announce_first must be cleared in four places by hand (set_history_a11y_focus, focus_in, rows_changed, chat change).
fix: enum HistoryFocus { Away, Idle, ArmedForFirst(ChatId), Bar, Row(MessageId) } owned by the chat's ChatUi / the window's slot.

title: ScrollDate keeps its stage in shown_at + last_scroll + hide_after + wake Option, with covered_row/top_label derived from probes
trigger: Scroll the history, stop, scroll again within the fade, switch chat.
effect: The stage (Hidden / Fading / Still) is recomputed from three timestamps by motion(), and wake: Option<Task> is a 'timer armed' flag that must be cleared by the task itself; covered_row is reset only when the pill is drawn.
fix: enum PillStage { Hidden, Showing{since,last_scroll,hold}, Armed{wake:Task} } replaced whole with HistoryUi on a chat change.

title: Scroller anchoring is spread over key, ends, window_epoch, anchor_pending, landing, last_highlight, highlight_fade, scroll_goal
trigger: Opening a chat, a jump, or a window replace.
effect: Each field is reset by hand in history_message_list.rs (key change resets last_highlight and scroll_date but not highlight_fade, landing, hit_rows, reported_visible).
fix: One enum Anchor { Idle, Pending{key,epoch}, Landing{..} } replaced whole on key change.

title: Row chrome refresh is a bool/Cell flag plus due list plus epoch stamps
trigger: Session change while rows are drawn.
effect: chrome_notify_pending (Cell<bool>) says a deferred notify is on its way; if the deferred task is dropped (window closed, screen replaced) the flag stays set and no further notify is queued.
fix: Replace the Cell<bool> with ChromeRefresh { Clean, Due(Vec<usize>), Notifying } owned by HistoryUi and cleared in the deferred task's drop path.

title: Tick tasks are tracked by Option<ChatId> 'Some exactly while the task runs'
trigger: Chat with self-destruct timers or a live location opens.
effect: self_destruct_tick_chat and live_location_tick_chat are cleared only from inside the task's own update closure; if the task's update fails (scope gone) the Some stays and the tick is never restarted for that chat in this HistoryUi.
fix: Hold the Task handle itself (Option<(ChatId, Task<()>)>) so dropping the owner stops the tick and the stage cannot outlive it.

title: width_probed/forum_column_shown/window_active are stage bools kept in step with paint
trigger: Resize, forum open, window focus.
effect: width_probed (Rc<Cell<bool>>) says whether the history measured itself; it is never reset when the pane changes, so seed_history_width only runs on first paint.
fix: enum HistoryWidthSource { Seeded(Pixels), Measured(Pixels) }.

title: Slider entities live in QuillApp.preferences, outside OnScreen
trigger: Open Data & Storage in account A, switch account.
effect: index_sliders (and AutoDelete slider) hold positions derived from account A's limits; dropped only by open_data_storage/forget_storage_sliders, not by an account swap.
fix: Move into the dialog's box state that is replaced with the account.

title: press_inline_results_button closes the panel by flipping two fields
trigger: Press the bot's button.
effect: inline_results_open=false and inline_query_armed=None are written beside the same pair in send_inline_pick/close_inline_results/sync_inline_mode (four writers).
fix: A single ChatUi::close_inline() or the InlineMode enum.

title: Member paging stage is four fields: shown, failed_offset, retry_at_scroll, admins_asked
trigger: Scrolling the members list.
effect: Four values kept in step by hand across inline_members.rs (maybe_load_more_inline, inline_members_stale, reset).
fix: enum MemberPaging { Idle, Requested{offset}, Failed{offset,retry:bool} } plus a separate Admins{Asked} stage.

title: MembersView carries loading: bool beside failed: Option<String>
trigger: Render of the members list.
effect: Derived from SupergroupMembersFetch each frame, so both cannot be wrong at once today, but the shape is the loading+error pair the rule rejects; the snapshot RefCell is also written during render.
fix: Use Fetch<Vec<MemberRow>> in the view.

title: Inline-mode query flow is spread over six fields in three owners
trigger: Typing @bot query in the composer.
effect: inline_results_open, inline_results_selected, inline_query_armed (Option used as 'timer armed' flag), inline_query_waiting (pending bool, taken and re-set in progress_inline_mode_here), composer_ui.inline_query_token and pending_inline_bot_alert are kept in step by hand; the session holds one inline_bot_resolve and one inline_query slot for every window.
fix: One ChatUi enum InlineMode { Off, Resolving{username}, Waiting{bot,query}, Armed{bot,query,token}, Showing{selected} } with the session slots keyed by window/chat.

title: Recording stage is spread over capture, start, locked, discard_confirm, once, voice_tick and preview
trigger: Hold-to-record, lock it, open the discard row, toggle play once, pause and preview; cancel, send or close the window.
effect: No bug today: end_capture_flags resets locked/discard_confirm/once/round_preview by hand in the take paths, but preview is cleared separately by callers (stop_record_preview) and voice_tick by the tick task.
fix: One enum Recording { Idle, Opening{..}, Recording{capture, mode: Held|Locked, once, confirm_discard}, Paused{.., preview} } so flags die with the capture; voice_tick becomes Option<Task>.

title: GIF playback stage is playing_animation + gif + gif_started_at + gif_decodes + autoplayed_gifs + intent
trigger: Autoplay or tap a GIF.
effect: Six fields in PlaybackUi are written by hand in stop_animation_playback, play_gif_file, gif_started, gif_decoded, leave_gifs_here and stop_gif_of_window.
fix: enum GifPlayback { Idle, Waiting{intent}, Decoding{key,cancel}, Playing{key,clip,started} }.

title: voice_tick is a bool 'task running' flag
trigger: Start a voice recording.
effect: Set before the task spawns and cleared only at the end of the task; it lives in RecordingUi (replaced on account switch) so it does not stick today.
fix: Hold Option<Task<()>> in the recording stage.

title: Slot play stage is asleep + hidden_since + sound + paused + seeking + bytes
trigger: Scrolling a clip away, clicking a round video, dragging its seek ring.
effect: wants_play() combines five of them; asleep implies bytes==0 and hidden_since==None, sound implies Release is skipped; set by hand in sweep, revive, toggle_sound, seek_to, end_seek.
fix: enum SlotStage { Playing, Held{since}, Asleep, Sounding{paused}, Seeking{was_playing} }.

title: A userpic player's slot holds its stage as hidden_since plus asleep, kept in step by hand
trigger: Scroll userpic videos out of view and back: the slot goes playing, off screen, asleep and revived.
effect: No bug found. Every writer sets asleep and clears hidden_since together, and State keeps sweep_due, timer and history_listed as extra flags.
fix: enum SlotStage { OnScreen, OffScreen { since }, Asleep } on Slot, with the player inside the awake variants.

title: OnDemand pairs a Demand with a hand-kept `started` bool
trigger: Click a round video or GIF
effect: Stages asked -> started -> ended live in a bool plus map membership
fix: enum DemandStage { Asked, Started, Ended } held in the slot, dropped with it

title: InlineReturn is a state machine in Option<String> pending_start plus baseline
trigger: Press an inline results switch-to-PM button
effect: Stages WaitingToOpen / StartSent{baseline} / Returned are pending_start.is_some() and baseline!=0 by hand
fix: enum InlineReturnStage { AwaitStart{param}, StartSent{baseline} }

title: InviteLinkBox holds `custom` Option and focus_custom bool that must move together
trigger: Open Custom limit/date
effect: focus_custom survives a set_invite_link_custom(None) and is consumed from a dialog build
fix: Put focus request inside CustomBox::Limit{input, focus_pending}

title: Checkout is form_loading + form_paid + form + note + validated + shipping_id + verification_started + dialog Option
trigger: Press Buy / open any invoice
effect: payment_dialog_visible derives stage from 3 fields by hand
fix: enum Checkout { Idle, LoadingForm{request}, Form, Paying, Paid, Failed{note} }

title: Shortcut capture is capture Option + error Option + applied bool reset by two free functions
trigger: Rebind a shortcut then leave the page or switch account
effect: capture/error/applied must be cleared in step (capture_active, invalidate_account_keybindings)
fix: enum Capture { Idle, Armed{id}, Rejected{id,msg} } plus keymap generation

title: Language switch flow is ready/patch/reload/error/switching/current taken field by field
trigger: drain_language takes ready, patch, reload and error from session.settings.language every frame; switching and current decide if a reload or an in-flight pick is ignored.
effect: Several fields move together by hand; no bug found today.
fix: One enum LanguageFlow { Idle, Fetching(list), Switching{info}, Installed, Failed(err) } with a queue of patches.

title: LayerDraw ticked bool and redrawn Option<Instant> describe one of three stages
trigger: The frame clock ticks a layer, then it draws once for the tick, then redraws on a vsync.
effect: ticked and redrawn are kept in step by ticked()/drawn(); no bug found today.
fix: enum LayerStage { Idle, Ticked, Redrawn(Instant) }.
